title: Self-assembled nanoplatform-mediated co-delivery of brusatol to sensitize sorafenib for hepatocellular carcinoma treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11675-11687
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00108K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fengrui Liu, Senlin Li, Chengcheng Huang, Zhenfei Bi, Xiao Xiang, Shuqi Zhang, Ruihao Yang, Lu Zheng
We developed a glutathione (GSH) responsive nanoplatform for the co-delivery of sorafenib (Sor) and brusatol (Bru). This nanoplatform enhanced Bru’s efficacy and increased Sor’s sensitivity. This innovative approach enhanced Sor’s effectiveness in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) treatment.
